about: The licences a package the app is built with may be under (SPDX ids), and the packages let through under another, each with the reason. Checked by `pnpm licences` (deploy/licences), in bin/ci-check. See docs/agents/licences.md.

exceptions.why: The layout engine itself (packages/layout). Ships as WebAssembly; MPL asks for its source, which is public in its own repository.
The app's font. Ships in every build; the Open Font License allows that with its notice, which NOTICE carries.
The CSS compiler of Vite and Tailwind. Runs while building; none of it is in the app.
Writes the favicon while building (@vite-pwa/assets-generator); none of it is in the app.
The image library behind sharp, which draws the app's icons while building (@vite-pwa/assets-generator); none of it is in the app.
Browser data that build tools read (browserslist); none of it is in the app.
